Cyclotomic.Description:
Description

Cyclotomic is a package for cyclotomic fields. It is used in to construct extensions of the coefficient field during binomial primary decomposition using the package Binomials.

cyclotomicField.Caveat:
Caveat

Strange things can happen with the reduction of the coefficients. In M2 v <= 1.2 dimension is off by one.
cyclotomicField.Description:
Description

i1 : S = cyclotomicField (5)

o1 = S

o1 : PolynomialRing
i2 : isField S

o2 = true
i3 : r = S_0

o3 = ww
       5

o3 : S
i4 : (r^9, r^10, r^11)

          3     2
o4 = (- ww  - ww  - ww  - 1, 1, ww )
          5     5     5           5

o4 : Sequence
i5 : T = S[x,y]

o5 = T

o5 : PolynomialRing
i6 : I = ideal (x-r)

o6 = ideal(x - ww )
                 5

o6 : Ideal of T
i7 : dim I

o7 = 1

joinCyclotomic.Description:
Description

i1 : F = cyclotomicField 3; G = cyclotomicField 4;
i3 : R = F[t]; I = ideal (t-F_0^2)

o4 = ideal(t + ww  + 1)
                 3

o4 : Ideal of R
i5 : S = G[t]; J = ideal (t^2-G_0)

            2
o6 = ideal(t  - ww )
                  4

o6 : Ideal of S
i7 : joinCyclotomic {I,J}

                  2           2     3
o7 = {ideal(t + ww  ), ideal(t  - ww  )}
                  12                12

o7 : List
